title: Rngcatgirl's Modpack
description: These are all the mods I, Rngcatgirl, use on stream and YouTube! This modpack combines useful quality-of-life features with powerful performance optimizations to create a smoother and more enjoyable Hypixel experience. (Recommendation add skyhanni)
body:
**Note: This modpack does not include SkyHanni or SBO.
**
  This is a performance-optimized client-side modpack designed specifically for playing on Hypixel, with a focus on smooth gameplay, useful quality-of-life features, and improved FPS. It includes essential SkyBlock mods for better UI, inventory management, and gameplay tracking, along with powerful optimization mods to reduce lag and stuttering. 
    
      This is the exact modpack I use for skyblock on stream and in videos.
      As of recently I have started using Skyhanni for QOL and SBO for Diana.
